verdict.rationale: Poly ships a `poly` command-line tool billed as making your files "searchable and scriptable from the terminal". Its agent skill describes creating, updating and organizing files by composing `poly` commands. A hosted MCP endpoint also offers programmatic access, though it is remote, OAuth-gated and aimed at AI assistants rather than a local script endpoint. missing for 10: a URI scheme or deep links for creating/opening notes, a local HTTP endpoint, evidence of opening a note in the app UI from outside, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI-based note creation.
